content.short: Wallet for receiving global income and spending/withdrawing locally.
content.description: Takenos is a financial platform for Latin American freelancers and contractors that lets them receive global income in stablecoins and spend or withdraw it locally. Users can get paid from clients and platforms abroad, hold balances in stablecoins such as USDT, and cash out to local currency across around 20 countries, with a card for everyday spending. Built on Solana and having processed hundreds of millions of dollars in payroll volume, Takenos also supports withdrawing USDT over networks including Polygon, Tron, and BNB Chain, bridging on-chain payouts with local money. It targets the region's large base of remote workers earning in dollars who face slow, expensive traditional cross-border payment options, turning stablecoins into a fast, low-cost way to get paid and access money at home.
content.meta: Takenos lets LatAm freelancers receive stablecoin income and cash out locally. Discover Takenos and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
